title: In-Context Learning Beyond Copying: A Training-Time Analysis of Abstractive ICL
abstract: arXiv:2511.05743v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The sudden emergence of induction circuits and the ability to perform in-context copying in LLMs coincides with a sharp drop in training loss over a short span of the training process. This co-occurrence has been cited as evidence that it marks the point at which a wide range of in-context learning (ICL) capabilities begin to emerge. To analyze the training dynamics of few-shot abstractive ICL capabilities (i.e., tasks where the answer is not contained in the input context), we propose Hapax, a training regime that omits the loss contribution of tokens predictable by the induction circuit to control training pressure for copying. Using this intervention, we find that abstractive ICL capabilities can still emerge, despite a substantial reduction in inductive copying and the absence of the characteristic phase changes observed during Vanilla training. Analysis of attention heads shows that Hapax-trained models develop fewer and weaker

translated_title: 超越复制的上下文学习：抽象式ICL的训练时分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型中归纳电路的突然涌现以及执行上下文复制的能力，与训练过程中短时间内的训练损失急剧下降相吻合。这一共现现象曾被引为证据，表明该时间点标志着广泛的上下文学习（ICL）能力开始涌现。为了分析少样本抽象式ICL能力（即答案不包含在输入上下文中的任务）的训练动态，我们提出了Hapax——一种训练机制，它通过省略归纳电路可预测的token的损失贡献，来控制复制相关的训练压力。通过这一干预，我们发现尽管归纳式复制大幅减少，且原始训练中观察到的特征性相变消失，抽象式ICL能力仍然能够涌现。对注意力头的分析显示，Hapax训练的模型发展出更少且更弱的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究通过Hapax训练机制抑制归纳复制并消除相变后，发现抽象式上下文学习能力仍能涌现，表明ICL能力并不依赖于归纳复制机制。
en_tdlr: Even when inductive copying is substantially suppressed and characteristic training phase changes are eliminated via the Hapax training regime, abstractive in-context learning capabilities still emerge, showing that ICL does not solely rely on induction-based copying mechanisms.
